newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products end mixed, high sulphur picks up.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products end mixed, high sulphur picks up.

text.p: NWE oil products ended mixed on Friday.
High sulphur fuel oil picked up after 25,000 tonnes was sold from the U.K. to a trader for a solid $80 fob. Low sulphur slid gently in a dead market facing over-supply.
Heating oil barges were steady - the 25-cent drop in premiums offset by similar gains on futures. Cargoes were a touch firmer, but only marginally.
Gasoline eased on continued light demand amid sloppy supply with Eurograde barges trading $191.50 and $192 a tonne fob ARA, but many players thought the market had hit its bottom.
